resources.string: Entry explanation

Rules clean candidate entries shown by Android or apps. In Hide selected mode, checking an entry hides it; in Show selected only mode, checked entries are kept. Rules do not set defaults, uninstall apps, or disable components. Real component enable/disable remains separate on the Root Components page.

Advanced entries only filter candidate discovery initiated by ordinary apps. System and privileged UID queries are left unchanged for safety, so service lists inside system Settings are not guaranteed to be hidden by these rules. Selecting an item does not grant/revoke permissions, enable/disable services, or change system defaults.
Apps and components offered for normal ACTION_SEND sharing. Selecting hides or keeps the chooser entry only; the target app is unchanged.
Candidates offered by ACTION_SEND_MULTIPLE when sharing multiple items; the items do not have to be files. This is managed separately from single-item sharing.

Recently observed Direct Share contacts, conversations, or sharing shortcuts shown at the top of the Android share sheet. Selecting hides that target from the chooser; contacts and conversations are not deleted.
Candidates handling ACTION_SENDTO. Discovery probes mailto, sms, smsto, mms, and mmsto so mail and messaging entries are not missed by ordinary Open scans.
Open-with candidates for files, MIME types, schemes, and configured file types. Selecting changes only which matching entries are presented.
Browser candidates for HTTP and HTTPS links. This filters browser choices; it does not change Android\'s current default browser.
HTTP/HTTPS App Link and web-domain handlers. This category is for web app links, not every custom URI scheme, and does not change verified-link state.
Apps offered for ACTION_DIAL / tel: links. Filtering candidates does not change the current default dialer.
Apps offered for ACTION_GET_CONTENT when an app asks the user to choose content. DocumentsProvider components inside the system picker are managed separately under Storage providers.
Handlers for ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT. This cleans the outer document-opening candidates; providers inside DocumentsUI are managed under Storage providers.
Handlers for ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT when saving or creating a document. It does not choose or change the default save location.
Camera or capture apps offered for ACTION_IMAGE_CAPTURE. Selecting only filters the capture chooser entry.
Camera or video apps offered for ACTION_VIDEO_CAPTURE. Selecting only filters the capture chooser entry.
Recorder apps offered for the standard record-sound Intent. Selecting only filters the chooser entry.
Apps and activities offered for selected-text actions such as translate, search, or process text. Text-processing lists are allowed to become empty.
Launcher candidates returned for HOME + CATEGORY_HOME and grouped under Desktop. This filters HOME candidates only and does not change the current default launcher.
Activity entries returned for ACTION_ASSIST and grouped under Actions. This is not full Assistant Role / VoiceInteractionService management and does not change the current default assistant.
Retired compatibility enum for older configurations. Old rules, ordering, and titles are discarded when read and are no longer shown or applied.

Enabled manifest or dynamic ShortcutInfo entries observed at runtime for launcher long-press menus. Pinned-only and cached shortcuts are excluded. The list is grouped by app so you can select all or expand and select individual items. Shortcut data itself is not deleted.
Storage Access Framework DocumentsProvider components such as cloud drives, file managers, or NAS providers. A provider may expose several storage roots; hiding a provider rule does not delete files.
InputMethodService candidates queried by ordinary apps. This does not enable, disable, or switch the current keyboard; system Settings lists are not guaranteed to be affected.
AutofillService candidates queried by ordinary apps. Filtering does not enable/disable Autofill or change the selected Autofill service.
CredentialProviderService candidates for credentials and passkeys, managed separately from AutofillService. Rules do not delete saved credentials or change the active provider.
NotificationListenerService candidates. This does not grant/revoke Notification Access or change the enabled state.
AccessibilityService candidates. This does not turn an accessibility service on/off or change its granted state.
VpnService candidates. This does not connect, disconnect, authorize, or set a default VPN.
PrintService candidates. Filtering does not enable/disable print services or change printer configuration.
WallpaperService live-wallpaper candidates. This does not apply, remove, or change the current wallpaper.
DreamService screensaver candidates. This does not enable screensaver mode or choose the active screensaver.
Host/off-host NFC card-emulation service candidates. This does not change AIDs, payment defaults, NFC routing, or enable/disable the service.
CallScreeningService candidates. This does not grant the call-screening role, enable call blocking, or change the current phone role.
